turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on Owen's zero, Hale, and was he heard before it went in?
Can I ask something off the record?
Nothing in this room is off the record. Who decided?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned here, Hale. On what basis is there a zero?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
Kids who cheat. Owen doesn't lie, and I won't sit here while you call my son a cheater and me a negligent mother.
